nodes.label: Vietnamese sound-hint mnemonics
nodes.rationale: Hints are mnemonics, not IPA; always paired with mouth shape and difference notes; tones are not equated with Vietnamese diacritics.

nodes.label: Pre-paint theme script (hanyu-settings localStorage)
nodes.rationale: Applies saved light/dark theme before first paint and sets page background inline so nothing flashes white before app CSS loads.

nodes.label: src/lib/migrateProgress.ts (legacy progress migration)
nodes.rationale: Old word-ID progress auto-migrated on app open; completed HSK 2.0 lessons mark all words in new list as remembered; review cards follow same-hanzi words.

nodes.label: PWA / iOS safe-area meta config
nodes.rationale: viewport-fit=cover lets env(safe-area-inset-*) report notch and home indicator; home-screen launch uses splash images in public/splash.

nodes.label: Hanzi Writer
nodes.rationale: Stroke data loaded over network; rare variants without stroke data fall back to a free-draw self-assessed board.

nodes.label: Web Speech API (Mandarin voice)
nodes.rationale: No automatic pronunciation scoring; recording lets learners self-compare instead.

nodes.label: Google Fonts (Be Vietnam Pro, Noto Serif SC)
nodes.norm_label: google fonts (be vietnam pro, noto serif sc)

nodes.label: LXGW WenKai GB font
nodes.rationale: Additional permission allows Reserved Font Names in recompiled or web-font subset/converted (WOFF/WOFF2) versions not offered as installable desktop fonts.

nodes.label: Course data sources (LICENSES.md)
nodes.rationale: The app does not bundle the books' PDFs, texts, grammar or exercises; only vocabulary and lesson titles.

nodes.label: IndexedDB progress storage (no account sync)
nodes.rationale: Progress is stored locally in browser IndexedDB; backup covers learning data, review schedule, intro sessions and radicals but not voice settings; restore requires preview and confirmation and writes in a single transaction.
